user.title: Connect to the A.O. Smith cloud
user.description: Paste the credentials captured from the official AI-LiNK app (China). The token is renewed automatically, so it only has to be captured once.

device.title: Select the water heater
device.description: Pick a device. The category in brackets is the cloud product class code, useful to confirm the model.

manual.title: Enter the device id manually
manual.description: Use this when device discovery returns nothing. The deviceId can be found in a captured request body.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the access token
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud rejected the stored token and it could not be renewed. Capture a new token and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed: wrong token / user_id / family_id, or the captured token is no longer accepted
error.signature_error: The cloud rejected our request signature (校验失败)
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the A.O. Smith cloud
error.device_not_found: Device not found, please check the deviceId

abort.already_configured: This water heater is already configured

data.extra_attributes: Expose every raw field on the water heater entity
data.create_all_switches: Create all switch entities, even unreported ones
